english.title: Make a false statement to procure a shotgun certificate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) for the purpose of procuring for yourself or another the

(A)_[grant]_
(B)_[renewal]_

of a shotgun certificate under the Firearms Act 1968, knowingly or recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28A(7) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
48 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
